label: rem:archimedean-chirality
title: Chirality as Reeb orientation
html:
Remark. Chirality as Reeb orientation

The Reeb vector field \xi on the CR manifold M carries a natural orientation. The sign of the contact form \varTheta(\xi) = 1 singles out a preferred direction along the vertical distribution. Left-handed and right-handed chiralities correspond to the two orientations of \xi relative to the complex structure of M. For fermions (fermion), the vertical component \alpha_V transforms with a definite sign under reversal of \xi. Chirality is therefore encoded in the \pm-eigenspaces of the Reeb involution \xi \mapsto -\xi. Bosons (boson), being purely horizontal, are chirality-blind. This is consistent with the observed parity invariance of the electromagnetic and strong interactions. Cf. [nicolaescu2005, petit-2005].
